title: Decoupling candidate dual AGN from chance superpositions in the GOTHIC survey via a deep-learning framework
abstract: arXiv:2608.24164v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Dual active galactic nuclei (DAGN) mark a critical phase in the evolution of merging galaxies and the pairing of supermassive black holes, yet they remain difficult to identify in large imaging surveys because of projection effects and limited spatial resolution. Compact foreground stars and unresolved substructure can mimic dual nuclei through chance superposition, complicating automated detection. We revisit the 46,061 galaxies flagged but rejected as DAGN candidates by the GOTHIC pipeline, primarily because the two nuclei fell within the SDSS fibre aperture or exceeded its separation threshold. We train a supervised deep-learning framework based on the YOLOv11 oriented-bounding-box architecture on annotated SDSS imaging to separate genuine dual nuclei from foreground stellar contaminants and other spurious alignments. translated_title: 基于深度学习框架在GOTHIC巡天中解耦候选双活动星系核与偶然叠加
translated_abstract: 双活动星系核（DAGN）标志着合并星系和超大质量黑洞配对演化中的关键阶段，然而由于投影效应和有限的空间分辨率，它们在大规模成像巡天中仍难以识别。致密前景恒星和未解析的子结构可能通过偶然叠加模拟双核，从而干扰自动检测。我们重新审视了GOTHIC流程中标记但被拒绝的46,061个DAGN候选星系，主要原因在于两个核落在SDSS光纤孔径内或超过其分离阈值。我们基于YOLOv11定向边界框架构，在带注释的SDSS成像上训练了一个监督深度学习框架，以区分真正的双核与前景恒星污染物及其他虚假对齐。最终模型在双核类别上实现了验证精度0.919、召回率0.905和F1分数0.912。
tldr: 本文通过YOLOv11定向边界框深度学习框架，有效从GOTHIC巡天的偶然叠加中区分出真实双活动星系核，实现了高精度检测。
en_tdlr: This paper uses a YOLOv11 oriented-bounding-box deep learning framework to effectively distinguish genuine dual active galactic nuclei from chance superpositions in the GOTHIC survey, achieving high detection accuracy.
